name: success_coach
style_suffix: bright high-key editorial photography, clean modern 2026 setting, crisp even natural daylight, deep focus and sharp clarity, vivid but tasteful saturated color, cool blue-forward grade with a warm accent, contemporary professional and credible, optimistic documentary realism
default_music_prompt: Calm reflective acoustic underscore for a professional development documentary. Soft warm piano, subtle string pads, restrained and hopeful but not saccharine. Light, considered, room for a narrator. No percussion, no obvious melody, slow build of thoughtfulness. Modern documentary tone.

thumbnail.candidate_prompt_suffix: a single real human face and upper body massed in the right two-thirds, a composed serious professional with a thoughtful or mildly concerned expression (never distressed, never exaggerated), looking toward camera, bright high-key professional lighting, clean modern setting, crisp vivid but tasteful color, photoreal and natural skin (not waxy or uncanny), the left third kept a simple uncluttered backdrop for the headline, no text, sixteen by nine
thumbnail.selection_rules: Pick the candidate with the most natural, believable, non-uncanny human face: reject distorted features, malformed hands, dead eyes, or waxy plastic skin. Want bright clean professional lighting, a clear readable expression that fits the topic, and the cleanest uncluttered left third where the headline lands. Premium and relatable, never cheap stock, never exaggerated shock-face. If no candidate has a clean face, pick the least distorted.
